text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD#P12345) — High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1. threshold=5% over 5m, current=12.3%. Link: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345|PD#P12345> -- routing + logs attached.

alice: ACK — oncall taking this. pulling logs and metrics now.

ben: seeing sharp jump at 2026-03-15T03:12:10Z in nginx-ingress. No user deploys in the last 30m from deploy-bot.

carol: LB metrics: envoys on node pool "igw-eu-west-1" show CPU up ~3x starting 03:11 UTC and active conns spiked. Also seeing increased conn resets.

dinesh: FYI cert-rotator-job ran at 03:10 (k8s job cert-rotator-2026-03-15). Job status: 204 responses, but logs show repeated `reload` restarts for envoy sidecar on some pods.

eve-support: Support has 4 customer tickets reporting truncated responses and upload failures around the same window. Severity: P2 for multiple business-critical flows.

alice: quick reproduce: curl POST to /v1/generate on gateway -> HTTP/1.1 502

alice: logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T03:11:58Z inference-gateway-abc123 envoy sidecar: "tls: handshake failure: EOF"
2026-03-15T03:12:01Z inference-gateway-abc123 kernel: "conntrack: table full, dropping packet"
2026-03-15T03:12:03Z inference-gateway-abc123 inference-service: "upstream error: connection reset by peer"
```

ben: interesting — conntrack table full + tls handshake failures. conntrack overflow can cause established connections to be dropped and upstream errors.

carol: kubectl top pods shows envoy sidecar CPU at 98% on 6/10 pods in the pool; some pods flapping their sidecar process around 03:10-03:13.

dinesh: probable chain: cert-rotator triggered reloads -> transient CPU/IO spike during reload on sidecar -> conntrack pressure on node -> LB began to see failed upstream conns -> 502/5xx spike. Need to verify but fits timeline.

alice: mitigation plan:
1) temporarily reduce weight for eu-west1 in global-route to 60% and increase fallback eu-north to 40%.
2) scale inference-gateway replicas by +4 to relieve conn pressure.
3) mark suspect nodes out of LB (drain) and let k8s reschedule.
4) if conntrack persists, bump conntrack_max on nodes as emergency.

ben: executing scale now: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=12` — patch applied.

carol: applying traffic weight change (canary route):
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap global-routing -p '{"data":{"eu-west1.weight":"60","eu-north.weight":"40"}}'
```

alice: traffic shift in progress. monitoring metrics.

incident-bot: PD update: Incident acknowledged by alice. Assigned to SRE & Platform.

dinesh: opening platform ticket and paging platform-sre rotation (PD#P12346) — linking both incidents.

carol: performed rolling restart of envoy sidecar on the 6 worst pods (one at a time). watching 5xx metric.

alice: after first three restarts, 5xx dropped from 12.3% -> 4.7% within 3m. After full rolling restart, stabilized at ~1.1%.

eve-support: Customer tickets show reductions in failures; pushing updates to affected customers A,B,C with initial RCA noting transient gateway errors.

ben: conntrack metrics clearing. kernel conntrack.nf_conntrack_count now normal.

dinesh: still want postmortem: short-term: add graceful reload to cert-rotator (avoid concurrent sidecar reloads). Medium-term: conntrack tuning + alert on cert-rotator job flapping.

alice: owners: cert-rotator -> dinesh, routing config -> ben, platform config (conntrack) -> carol. I'll draft postmortem.

frank: ack — taking night shift watch. I'll keep PD on watch and re-reoute traffic back if any regressions. ping me for handoff notes.

alice: handing off live monitoring to @frank — will follow up in morning with postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:

frank: ACK. I'll monitor graphs (5xx, conntrack, envoy CPU) for next 4 hours and escalate if >1% 5xx for 10m.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (routing + restarts). PD#P12345 set to "acknowledged"; further updates will go to PD#P12346 (platform).
summary: Automatic pager for 5xx spike on inference-gateway caused by cert-rotator-induced sidecar reloads + conntrack pressure, mitigated by rolling restarts, scaling, and traffic shift. Handed off to night oncall.
